title: Sales Tax — Effective Date is shown one day early (UTC midnight rendered in browser local time)
requirementSource: NM-4021 §4.1/§4.2 — Effective Date shows the effective date of the version (MM/DD/YYYY); same root cause as BUG-TAX-IST-001
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Tax → Sales Tax for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/taxes/sales-tax) on e2e as the automation user.
Type Zip Code 90210 and click Search.
Compare the Effective Date cell with the effectiveDate in the search response (DevTools → Network).
expectedBehavior: The grid shows 04/01/2025 — the calendar date the version is stored with.
actualBehavior: The server sends effectiveDate '2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z'; the grid shows 03/31/2025 in a browser running America/New_York. The History tab shows the same shift. The cell formats the UTC instant with the browser's local timezone, so every user west of UTC sees each date one day early.

verificationLog.finding: Reproduced live on e2e (office 1101) during NM-4021 automation; the affected test asserts the documented behaviour under test.fail.
Also reproduced on the Sales Tax History tab (TC-TAX-ST-064).
